def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    sep=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg=c.most_common(2)[1][0]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(v==sep for v in r)]
    cols=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if all(r[j]==sep for r in g)]
    def segs(idx,n):
        out=[];s=0
        for i in idx: out.append((s,i)); s=i+1
        out.append((s,n)); return out
    rs,cs=segs(rows,len(g)),segs(cols,len(g[0]))
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in rs:
        orow=[]
        for c0,c1 in cs:
            n=sum(1 for r in g[r0:r1] for v in r[c0:c1] if v not in (sep,bg))
            orow.append(1 if n>=2 else bg)
        out.append(orow)
    return out
